rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: Anti-Cover when Shooting
rules.description: This model gets Anti-Cover on its weapons when shooting.

rules.name: Anti-Cover when Shooting Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Anti-Cover on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Blast
rules.description: If the target is hit all models within 4“ of it are also hit by this weapon.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Guarded
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Guarded, they always get +1 to Defense rolls from Guarded (instead of only when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Sturdy
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Sturdy, they always get +1 to Defense rolls from Sturdy (instead of only when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Sturdy Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Sturdy. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Fortified
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Guarded
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Defense rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.

rules.name: Hero
rules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

rules.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +6" range on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Infiltrate
rules.description: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3" away from enemy unit.

rules.name: Infiltrate Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Infiltrate. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Melee Slayer
rules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Mend
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

rules.name: Precision Frenzy
rules.description: Place one token on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two tokens. For each token all models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls until the end of the game.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Regeneration Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Scourge
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, enemies count as having taken 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.

rules.name: Slow
rules.description: Moves -2” when using Advance, and -4” when using Rush/Charge.

rules.name: Stealth
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Stealth Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Sturdy
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Defense rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.

rules.name: Swift
rules.description: This model may ignore the Slow rule.

rules.name: Swift Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Swift. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unique Hero
rules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

rules.name: Unpredictable
rules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Fighter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Unwieldy
rules.description: Strikes last when charging.

spells.name: Armor Rune
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Sturdy once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Battle Rune
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get +6" range on its weapons when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Breaking Rune
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 24" in line of sight, which takes 3 hits with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

spells.name: Cleaving Rune
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 1 hit with Blast(3).

spells.name: Deceleration Rune
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Smiting Rune
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with Scourge.
